// Package badaliasedexample is a synthetic KNOWN-BAD fixture for
// qdrant_client_convergence_test.go's
// TestQdrantClientConstructedOnlyByNewQdrantClient. Scanned under the
// display path "internal/example/aliased_test.go", it covers two bypass
// shapes a plain-name-only matcher would miss: an import ALIAS (qc), and a
// separate DOT-IMPORT spec of the same path — a dot-import makes unqualified
// calls invisible to this scanner, so it is itself recorded as a violation
// rather than silently ignored. Must scan dirty with exactly two findings.
//
// This file carries a .go.txt extension deliberately: it is parsed from
// source bytes by go/parser, never built by `go build`/gofmt/go vet/the
// linter, so it is not swept by any of them.
package badaliasedexample

import (
	qc "github.com/qdrant/go-client/qdrant"
	. "github.com/qdrant/go-client/qdrant"
)

func dialAliased(host string, port int) (*qc.Client, error) {
	return qc.NewClient(&qc.Config{Host: host, Port: port})
}
